long_biography.plain_text:
Trained in business economics, Alessandra Gucci pursued a brief professional venture in luxury accessories rather than joining the namesake fashion house. AG Limited Editions launched with The First, a collection of ninety-nine handbags produced in eleven examples of each design. Its small, highly selective distribution network supported later collections, but the label ceased releasing new work after 2010.

This creative work was separate from her inherited wealth. She and her sister Allegra became joint beneficiaries of their father's estate. Before that transfer, their father had sold his remaining company interest to Investcorp, so Alessandra did not inherit ownership of the Gucci brand. Her present occupation, investment portfolio and governance roles remain private.
